conventions: מְרַאֲשֹׁתָיו (v7, v11, v12, v16) is a bare adverbial noun with no preposition on it: it takes the ASV's supplied at or from under rule 33 and the suffix takes his; where it is the predicate of a relative clause (v11 that is at his head, v16 that was at his head) the construction's copula joins the noun's unit under rule 20.

בַּמַּעְגָּל (v5, v7) → within the place of the wagons: the assimilated article takes the first the, and place of the wagons is one unit on מַעְגָּל headed on wagons under rule 31, the second the and the of being the ASV's own expansion of the single substantive rather than a construct relation.

The oath חַי־יְהוָה כִּי (v16) and חַי־יְהוָה כִּי אִם (v10): the adjective takes As ... liveth (rule 55), the name its own word, and the oath particles כִּי and אִם are each unrepresented, the ASV writing nothing for them; the v10 margin Or, either was read and set aside.
report: Read all 25 verses end to end against the candidate table and the dump. No construction is analysed two ways without the ASV licensing the difference.

Recurring chains are consistent: the hill of Hachilah (v1, v3), the cruse of water (v11, v12, v16) and the children of men (v19) all put the fronted the on the rectum's article and leave the construct bare (rule 29); the top of the mountain (v13) and one of the people (v15) are the arthrous case and give each the to its own word.

מראשתיו is read alike in v7, v11, v12 and v16: the bare noun takes the ASV's supplied at/from (rule 33), with the construction's copula joining it only where it is the predicate of a relative clause (v11, v16). מעגל → place of the wagons is one unit on the noun in v5 and v7, the assimilated article taking the first the. The ועתה pairs (v8, v11, v16, v19, v20) and ולמה (v15) give the adverb its own word and the waw the connective left over. The oath חי־יהוה כי(אם) leaves כי and אם unrepresented in both v10 and v16.

The phrasal-particle rulings differ by verb, not by construction: out of sent out (v4) is added because sent alone writes שלח, while driven out, come out, stirred up, delivered up, went over, come over and gat away keep particles their bare verbs do not write. The ten added units (having v2; out v4; it ×2 v12; that v14; It v17; it be ×2 and that v19; my v23) each answer to no morpheme and no verse folds the same supply elsewhere.

Single-verse choices with a named competing reading were left as the verse pass took them: v1's supplied which is folded into the על־פני unit on rule 41's attributive reasoning (v3 has a written אשר, so it is not a split); v16's noncompositional sons of death → are worthy to die; v8's smite ... the second time on שנה; v20's a on the written אחד. v20's מנגד → away from with נגד unrepresented is defensible under rule 40 but a rule 23/30 fusion of the two prepositions was available; noted, not changed.

BSB disagreements are convention: the Td, R and C classes are the documented article/preposition/waw differences; v11 י and נו are silenced by the Jehovah forbid and let us go recastings (rule 40); v14 הֲ is a question marked by inversion alone (rule 17); v18 זה after למה is unrendered (rule 22); v23 את is rule 16; v25's second גם is the both...and count of rule 14. None is an error.
No promotion or amendment: nothing here generalises beyond rules already in the contract.
